notes.title: OK Bob, It's the Full Release!
notes.notes:
The day is here! 

From here on out there will be no more major changes to OK Bob. I'll be focused mostly on fixing bugs as soon as they come up, so please let me know if you run into any!

Achievements and trading cards are not out of the question, so stay tuned.

Big thank you to everyone who supported this endeavor!


Happy escaping,

Stephen

notes.title: Ready for Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The plan is to release the full game tomorrow, just barely meeting our self-imposed end of March deadline!

The major known bugs have been fixed, and I've polished up a number of components based on beta tester feedback. Please let me know if you run into any issues.


Thanks and happy Bob-ing!

Stephen
